summary: The pinned bundle and recorded sandbox run are valid, and fixture-based positive, negative, offline, and recovery checks pass. The live sim path does not perform the required five-category reconciliation against live AP state, and offline validation accepts invalid sentinel/status combinations.
findings: The live `--ap-url` path fabricates MC/TH logs with `build_default_mc_ok_log()` and `build_default_th_ok_log()`. Its five-category positive report uses a default AP snapshot for temperature and filament, while only job and mesh data come from live endpoints; the live snapshot is OFFLINE. Thus the passing live run does not establish five-category reconciliation against live sim state or real debug streams.

The required live full-stack negative and recovery loop is not exercised. `verify_additional_fault_injections()` and the post-fault report use in-memory golden fixtures; they do not inject faults into, or verify recovery from, the live gateway path.

`reconcile_offline_snapshot()` accepts either sentinel value for each temperature field and permits HTTP 504, although the contract specifies unit-specific sentinel values (2147483646 millidegrees and 32767 deci-degrees) and HTTP 503. Invalid offline responses can therefore pass this check.
The 5x5 leveling check only requires 25 flattened points; it can accept a malformed grid shape such as one row containing 25 values. The contract requires a 5x5 grid.
accepted_scope: Reviewed the exact TWIN-46 revision 1 contract, pinned test_harness diff, bundle hash, checkout and server evidence, and the recorded fixture and sim-mode test outputs. Software and sim-mode integration are in scope. Physical MCU USB/UART HIL and cross-compiler ELF builds are excluded as specified; this review makes no claim about unexecuted HIL.
unexecuted: Full-stack sim positive reconciliation of all five categories using live AP state and corresponding debug-log inputs.
Full-stack live mismatch, CRC/drop, OFFLINE-lock, and recovery checks against the running gateway.
Negative checks proving unit-specific offline sentinel enforcement, rejection of non-503 lock responses, and rejection of malformed leveling grid shapes.
